purpose: Replace fragile hand-written SSH command payloads with a durable Codex launcher and make GitHub authentication persistent for the VM source repo.

ssh_launcher.implementation_note: Non-interactive commands are sent to remote bash on stdin so command parsing happens on the VM rather than in the local Windows shell.

github_auth.remote_policy: Git remotes remain token-free; credentials are supplied by Git's VM-local credential helper.

verification.command: C:\Users\Ryan\.codex\openclaw\ocssh.cmd "printf 'PWD='; pwd; printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current; printf 'STATUS='; git status --short --branch"

verification.result: origin and upstream use token-free HTTPS URLs

operator_rule: Agents should use ocssh.cmd for VM commands, Q:\opt\openclaw for mounted source edits, and normal git push/fetch from /opt/openclaw. Do not embed GitHub tokens in command lines or remote URLs.
